prompts.prompt:
integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] A cinematic close-up of a red ceramic teapot on a pale wooden table. A thin ribbon of white steam rises from the spout and curls in warm morning sunlight. A green plant is softly blurred behind it. The camera remains locked off.
overall_soundscape: Gentle birdsong outside and a quiet room ambience.
non_diegetic_music: N/A

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] A bright yellow toy bus drives slowly from left to right across a dark blue tabletop. Exactly three small red wooden blocks stand beside its route. The camera stays fixed as the bus passes the blocks.
overall_soundscape: A quiet toy motor and soft rolling wheels.
non_diegetic_music: N/A

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] A macro shot of a fuzzy bumblebee sitting on a violet flower in a sunlit garden. The bee slowly moves its translucent wings while its legs remain on the petals. Blurred green foliage fills the background. The camera stays fixed.
overall_soundscape: A gentle bee buzz and light outdoor ambience.
non_diegetic_music: N/A

protocol.design: Two excluded end-to-end canaries followed by six paired workloads (three scenes x two seeds), AB/BA counterbalanced; fresh encoder and fresh TP2 servers per run; serial rank GPU placement; no production changes
protocol.timing: Encoder cold-file load + projection load, tokenize, first encode; complete staged pipeline from encoder controller start through AV history completion, including process startup/serialization/shutdown/transition; denoiser request and phases also separate. No encoder warmup or diagnostic encodes inside measured trials.
protocol.scope: Text-to-video, low resolution 5.17-second clips, two seeds; does not qualify image/reference conditioning, maximum capacity or production use

quality_method: Anonymous A/B contact sheets, six evenly spaced frames per clip; notes recorded before reading label mapping. Full AV decoding separately; no perceptual non-inferiority or audio semantic claim.

decision.headline: The projected 8B path reduces encoder loading and encoder memory, while complete generation time remains close and variable. The tested text-to-video scenes remain coherent, with composition and detail changes.
decision.assessment: Treat stock 8B + ClipProj as a viable isolated candidate for this bounded text-only workload. Before scheduled preparation, encoder load falls by 35.1% and the complete-request median by only 4.0%. Across all six pairs, complete-generation medians are effectively equal, and two late 8B runs overlap scheduled CPU preparation. Encoder VRAM/RSS savings are substantial; whole-pipeline owned RAM is almost unchanged because the denoiser/VAE still dominates. These results support a memory/loading option within the tested workload; broader quality and production performance remain unqualified.
decision.quality_summary: All six outputs per arm retain the requested main scenes in the sampled frames. Projected 8B shows clearer spout attachment in the two teapot seeds and smaller red blocks matching the relative-size instruction in the bus seeds. Both bus paths retain three initial red blocks and rightward motion, with later occlusion. Bee pairs retain macro detail and evolving wing/body pose without a clear overall sampled winner. Framing, pot/bus design and background details change; exact continuous leg contact and transient defects between sampled frames remain unqualified.
decision.next_action: The comparison is complete; no benchmark work or automatic retry remains. Keep the candidate isolated and retain the existing production selection. Broader reference-image, speech/audio semantics, long-prompt or production integration would be a separate qualification scope.
